title_sq: Apartament 2+1 per shitje tek Stadiumi Dinamo.
description_sq: Apartament 2+1 ofrohet per shitje tek Stadiumi Dinamo prane Komunes se Parisit. Ndertim shume mire i administruar dhe teper cilesor. Shkalle me ndricim natyral dhe ashensor. Fasade e termoizoluar. Hapesire e mireorganizuar dhe kubature e rregullt. Totalisht e arreduar ne menyre bashkekohore dhe teper komode. Orientim mjaft i mire cka i mundeson drite natyrale dhe diell. Organizohet ne 2 dhoma gjumi. Ambient ndenjie i bollshem+kuzhine gatimi. 2 Tualet njeri prej te cileve me dritare. Parket. 2 Ballkone te bollshme. Sistem kondicionimi inverter. Pamje e lire. Zone mjaft e preferuar, e qete dhe lehtesisht e aksesueshme. Disponon certifikate pronesie.
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale at Dinamo Stadium.
description_en: 2+1 apartment is offered for sale at Dinamo Stadium near Paris Municipality. Very well managed and high quality building. Staircase with natural light and elevator. Thermally insulated facade. Well-organized space and regular cubature. Totally furnished in a contemporary and very comfortable way. Very good orientation, which allows natural light and sun. It is organized in 2 bedrooms. Spacious living room + kitchen. 2 toilets, one of which has a window. Parquet. 2 spacious balconies. Inverter air conditioning system. Free view. Very favorite area, quiet and easily accessible. It has ownership certificates.
